what: Follow-up of 01100 (port of main #1552, link only the crates a program names). Roots and #[used] statics now come only from named crates (hir_def::nameres::named::named_dependencies, used by hir-ty-codegen linked_crates), but blaze-cargo serve/unit/codegen.rs natives() still walks every crate of job.graph.linked_in(unit) and adds each one's build-script rustc-link-lib -l and #[link] libraries. rustc loads only the crates the code names (plus their own named deps, transitively), so an unnamed dependency contributes no native library to rustc's link line. Filter linked_in to the crates the frontend links (the transitive closure of named_dependencies from the unit's crate, as linked_crates walks it), keeping rustc's order. Test: a dependency with a build script printing rustc-link-lib=<missing lib> that the program does not name links; named, it fails to find the lib.
